## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `bun run check` green
- [ ] Spec and CLAUDE.md updated if structure or contracts changed
- [ ] No third-party course content (also not in fixtures)
- [ ] User-facing strings in en/ru/de catalogs
- [ ] Migration + migration test if stored data changed

## Review questions

- Is anything built that the stage does not need?
- Could an existing entity cover a new one?
- Is logic duplicated?
- Is every change in the module that owns it?
